opening: Thirty days is the filing period for your first Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if you enter Taiwan on a resident visa and receive residence permission. Count from the day after arrival. [Immigration Act Article 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22) requires the application to the National Immigration Agency (NIA), which issues the card as evidence of approved residence.

Visitors have a different starting point: they must qualify for a permitted change to residence before they can apply. Holding a valid combined document with ARC functions, such as an Employment Gold Card, removes the need for a separate card under the exception in [Article 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22).

## Documents that establish your residence basis
end_before_sources: Check the issued card against your application. The name, passport details, address and residence expiry date should match the approved particulars; keep the receipt and decision with your immigration records.

An ARC alone does not authorize every job. Before starting work, the relevant permit or exemption must cover the actual employment under [Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 48](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001). Once you have the card, its expiry date and any later changes to your address or employment determine the next filings; travel may also require attention to re-entry permission. Those situations are covered in the [renewal and changes guide](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-renewal-changes-reentry).

Sources checked October 24, 2026. This procedural guide concerns foreign nationals and does not determine individual eligibility. Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

opening: Visa-exempt entry may suit a qualifying professional who intends to apply for residence in Taiwan, but it can rule out the ordinary in-country application for a degree or Mandarin student. [Foreign Professionals Act Article 16](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) permits the professional route; BOCA's [degree-study](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html) and [Mandarin-study guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-158-260-9690c-2.html) set different entry conditions for students.

Nationality and the passport used determine visa eligibility. The [Taiwan overseas mission handling your application](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html) provides the nationality-specific requirements and document procedures.

end_before_sources: Working-holiday access depends on the [nationality-specific program](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-153-2.html). The [digital-nomad visitor visa](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-158-7718-c0382-2.html) has separate nationality and qualification requirements and does not automatically lead to an ARC. [Foreign Professionals Act Article 14](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) limits that remote-work route to qualifying work without providing services to Taiwan businesses or employers.

Once the residence category and entry requirements are established, the [first ARC application guide](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-first-application) covers filing and collection. An existing resident moving to a new job, course or family basis also needs the [rules on renewal and changes](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-renewal-changes-reentry): the current card does not settle whether that new purpose qualifies.

Sources checked October 24, 2026. Eligibility still depends on the individual application. These routes concern foreign nationals; Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

opening: Can you stay until the expiry date printed on your Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if the job, course or family relationship supporting it ends sooner? [Immigration Act Article 31](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=31) requires the National Immigration Agency (NIA) to revoke residence permission and cancel the card when the reason for residence disappears, subject to the statutory grounds on which NIA may approve continued residence.

The date of that change can trigger an application well before the card expires. Keep the notice recording it. An employment termination notice, graduation record or family-status document helps establish what happened and when; a new lease records a move. [NIA's residence guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970) requires evidence suited to the extension or change requested.

end_before_sources: Before departing while a renewal or replacement is pending, obtain NIA's instructions for the actual journey. An application receipt should not be assumed to replace the required travel documents, particularly when the new card will not be ready before you leave.

Initial applications are covered in [first ARC steps](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-first-application); a new residence purpose is covered in the [work, study and family comparison](/en/columns/taiwan-visa-residence-work-study-family). Permanent residence has its own requirements, addressed in [APRC applications](/en/columns/taiwan-permanent-residence-aprc). For an upcoming trip, the immediate issue remains whether the documents you will carry cover the date you plan to return.
